pains.name: Device operation in cold-storage and outdoor conditions
pains.description: Devices must work reliably from -20C to 45C in warehouse yards and cold-storage aisles

hardware.howItAddresses: Confirmed operating range covers cold storage and outdoor yards
High-brightness display stays readable at outdoor loading docks

pains.name: Unauthorized use of company devices
pains.description: Shared devices get used for non-work apps, risking data leakage and support overhead

features.name: Kiosk Lockdown Mode
features.description: Restricts a device to a curated set of approved apps for frontline workers
features.howItAddresses: Locks the device to approved work apps only, preventing unauthorized use on shared devices

pains.name: Slow, error-prone manual data entry
pains.description: Manual entry of item codes causes picking errors and slows fulfillment

features.name: High-Speed Barcode Engine
features.description: Fast 1D/2D barcode capture tuned for warehouse pick-and-pack workflows
features.howItAddresses: High-speed scan engine reduces mis-scans and speeds up pick-and-pack

features.name: Scan Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Shows scan volume and error rates broken down by device and by shift
features.howItAddresses: Per-shift, per-device error-rate visibility lets a supervisor spot and correct mis-scan patterns instead of discovering them later

badge.label: Pilot feature — limited field data so far

pains.name: Long onboarding time for seasonal staff
pains.description: Seasonal hires need devices configured and ready within hours, not days

features.name: Zero-Touch Enrollment
features.description: Enrolls large batches of devices automatically at first power-on
features.howItAddresses: Automated zero-touch enrollment gets a new hire's device ready in minutes, not days

hardware.howItAddresses: Hot-swappable battery avoids downtime during seasonal peak shift handoffs

pains.name: Network dead zones in large facilities
pains.description: Large warehouses have Wi-Fi dead zones, often near metal racking, that interrupt scanning workflows

features.name: Offline Scan Queueing
features.description: Queues scan events locally when connectivity drops and syncs them automatically once the connection returns
features.howItAddresses: Local queueing means a dead zone does not stop the scanning workflow; every event syncs once back in range
